desc:
A Normal Button Simulator. This an incremental game about stepping on buttons. Press on buttons to earn stats, and use those stats to press even more buttons. Go explore the many zones this game has to offer, and uncover secrets that may get you ahead of the other players in the game. It's a simple gameplay loop that totally won't have many variations of gameplay later down in the road.

⭐ Current Best Stat: Realitium
🌍 Current Furthest World: World 8 [Heart Of Reality]
